# Array Functions

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Length](/docs/standard-library/array/length) | Gives the size of a string, an array or an object. |
| [Append](/docs/standard-library/array/append) | Adds a value to the end of an array. |
| [Prepend](/docs/standard-library/array/prepend) | Adds a value to the start of an array. |
| [First](/docs/standard-library/array/first) | Gives the first element of an array. |
| [Last](/docs/standard-library/array/last) | Gives the last element of an array. |
| [IndexOf](/docs/standard-library/array/indexof) | Finds the position of the first occurrence of a piece of text in a string, or of a value in an array. |
| [Reverse](/docs/standard-library/array/reverse) | Reverses the order of the elements of an array. |
| [Slice](/docs/standard-library/array/slice) | Takes the elements of an array between two positions. |
| [Concatenate](/docs/standard-library/array/concatenate) | Joins two arrays into one. |
| [Distinct](/docs/standard-library/array/distinct) | Removes the repeated elements of an array, keeping the first of each. |
| [Sort](/docs/standard-library/array/sort) | Sorts the elements of an array in ascending order. |
| [Flatten](/docs/standard-library/array/flatten) | Flattens an array of arrays, at every level of nesting, into one array. |
| [Range](/docs/standard-library/array/range) | Makes an array of numbers that count from a start toward a finish by a step. |
| [Skip](/docs/standard-library/array/skip) | Drops a number of elements from the start of an array. |
| [Insert](/docs/standard-library/array/insert) | Inserts a value into an array at a given position. |
| [RemoveAt](/docs/standard-library/array/removeat) | Removes the element at a given position of an array. |
| [RemoveFirst](/docs/standard-library/array/removefirst) | Removes the first element of an array. |
| [RemoveLast](/docs/standard-library/array/removelast) | Removes the last element of an array. |
| [FlattenOnce](/docs/standard-library/array/flattenonce) | Flattens one level of nesting in an array of arrays. |
| [RandomChoice](/docs/standard-library/array/randomchoice) | Picks an element of an array at random. |
| [SortByField](/docs/standard-library/array/sortbyfield) | Sorts an array of objects by the value of one of their properties. |
| [GroupBy](/docs/standard-library/array/groupby) | Groups the objects of an array by the value of one of their properties. |
| [SelectMany](/docs/standard-library/array/selectmany) | Collects the elements of an array property of each object in an array into one array. |
